Mali.title: Mali: Abdoulaye Diop discusses the impact of cooperation with Russia on the army
Mali.summary: The Malian Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Abdoulaye Diop, gave an interview to African Initiative following the third Russia-Africa summit, held in Moscow on 28 and 29 October 2026. For him, the partnership with Moscow has allowed the Malian army to strengthen and regain the initiative on the ground . He salutes the Russian troops engaged alongside the Malian forces, and the sacrifices made in this joint work.

Mali.title: Russia-Africa Summit: Presidents GOÏTA and PUTIN open a new stage of the Mali-Russia partnership
Mali.summary: The President of the Malian Transition, Army General Assimi GOÏTA, was received on Friday, October 30, 2026, in the Kremlin by his Russian counterpart, Mr. Vladimir PUTIN, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit. The Head of State was accompanied by the Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Mr.

Mali.title: Massive resupply in Bamako: A new convoy of 596 tanks secured by FAMa
Mali.summary: 596 new cisterns in Bamako! This Saturday, October 31, 2026, around 7 am, a convoy of 596 tankers arrived in the parking lots of Bamako, after having crossed the night under the escort of our valiant Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), which we salute for their commitment and courage. It should be recalled that before the arrival of this convoy, 415 loaded tanks still remained in the parks .

Mali.title: Bamako: 596 new tanker trucks arrived this Saturday
Mali.summary: A convoy of 596 tanker trucks arrived in Bamako this Saturday, October 31, 2026, around 7 a.m. It travelled at night under the escort of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), announces the Directorate General of Trade and Competition (DGCC) . With the 415 tanks already present in the car parks, more than 1,000 tanks of petroleum products are now available to supply depots and service stations.

Mali.title: Mali: another deadly landslide at a gold panning site in Kangaba
Mali.summary: Six Burkinabe nationals perished on Friday in the collapse of a gallery on a gold mining site in the Kangaba circle, in southwest Mali, near the Guinean border. The tragedy occurs in one of the main artisanal gold basins of the country, already marked by several deadly accidents . The landslide occurred on October 30 in Dioulafoundou, in the rural commune of Nouga, attached to the Kangaba circle in the Koulikoro region.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Western Sahara: the non-renewal of MINURSO, a significant step towards the definitive closure of the file at the UN
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 31 (map/FAAPA) The non-renewal of MINURSO by the Security Council at its meeting of October 30, 2026, is a significant step towards the definitive closure of the Sahara file at the United Nations, says a Cabinet statement . The non-renewal of the mandate of MINURSO clearly means that the presence of this Mission in the southern provinces of Morocco, in particular through its personnel, vehicles, equipment and symbols, should cease in the coming days, adds the same source.

Mali.title: Kremlin Summit: General Assimi Goïta and Vladimir Putin breathe new life into the Mali-Russia partnership
Mali.summary: Bilateral meeting in the Kremlin: President Assimi GOÏTA and Vladimir PUTIN open a new stage of the Mali-Russia partnership The President of the Transition, Head of State, His Excellency Army General Assimi GOÏTA, was received this Friday, October 30, 2026 in the Kremlin by his Russian counterpart, Mr. Vladimir PUTIN, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit .

Mali.title: Month of Solidarity and the Fight against Exclusion: The Autonomous Port of Dakar respects tradition
Mali.summary: As part of its social responsibility approach, the Autonomous Port of Dakar (PAD) is actively participating in the Month of Solidarity in Mali . This Friday, October 30, 2026, he renewed his support for vulnerable people through a major donation for the benefit of wards of the Nation, widows and drivers who are victims of acts of terrorism. The presentation ceremony of these donations was held at the General Directorate of the National Office of Pupils of Mali (ONAPUMA) .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina/Tribute to the martyrs of the popular insurrection: "Burkina Faso will be totally free, sovereign and independent", reaffirms (...)
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina/Tribute to the Martyrs of the Popular Insurrection: "Burkina Faso will be totally free, sovereign and independent", reaffirms Captain Ibrahim Traoré On the occasion of the National Day of Tribute to the Martyrs, this Saturday, October 31, 2026, the President of Faso, Captain Ibrahim Traoré, paid tribute to the victims of the popular insurrection and to those who fell in defense of the homeland In his message, the Head of State praised the resilience of the bereaved families, expressed his solidarity with the wounded and reaffirmed his commitment to continue the struggle for the total liberation of Burkina…

Burkina Faso.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Burkina Faso.title: Kangaba: six (6) dead in the collapse of a mining well in Nouga
Burkina Faso.summary: Kangaba, October 30 (AMAP) Six (6) people died Friday, in the collapse of a mining well, transformed into a gallery, in the rural commune of Nouga precisely in a very isolated gold mining site in the village of Dioulafoundou, learned AMAP from local sources. The same source specifies that the people who died are all nationals of Burkina Faso Immediately informed, the Prefect of Circle, accompanied by officials of the Police, the National Gendarmerie, the National Guard, the Civil Protection Rescue Center, the Sanitation and Water and Forestry Services, went to the scene.

Niger.title: Summary of the visit of the Minister of Refoundation and Promotion of Social Values to Tahoua
Niger.summary: Tahoua, Oct 31 (ANP)- The Minister of Refoundation and Promotion of Social Values, Mr. Abdourahamane Oumarou undertook from 25 to 30 October 2026 a working visit to the Tahoua region, on the occasion of the 13th edition of the Dan Gourmou Prize held from 24 to 29 October 2026 . In his address on the occasion of the closing of the Dan Gourmou Prize, 2026 edition, the Pan-Africanist Minister Abdourahamane first paid tribute to the defence and security forces who fell while defending the homeland .

Niger.title: Niger: Several mercenaries neutralized through various operations to secure the national territory
Niger.summary: Niamey, Oct 31 (ANP)-The Defense and Security Forces have neutralized seven(7) mercenaries through several operations to secure the national territory, report the narrative of the Integrated Operations Coordination Center (CICO) of the second half of October 2026 . Thus, within Operation Damissa; in the border area with Nigeria, the Defence and Security Forces continue their actions against the mercenaries who maintain insecurity there "It is in this context that the Tarnatsa operation of opportunity was launched, marked by the passage to the offensive of the ground forces against several enemy landmarks.

Niger.title: Algeria-Niger: Algiers authorizes the deployment of soldiers to protect its interests
Niger.summary: According to the Algerian website Bladi.net, the Algerian Parliament authorized, on Sunday, October 25, the deployment of military units in Niger. This decision comes four days after the signing of a military cooperation agreement between the two countries. According to Reuters, Algiers intends to protect its economic and energy interests This deployment comes after the dispatch, at the end of August, of four Sukhoi Su-30 fighter jets to Niamey, following an attempt to destabilize the Nigerien power.

Niger.title: Algeria and Libya – Haftar and red lines on Niger border
Niger.summary: Summary A war of words has been renewed between eastern Libya and Algeria following its move towards Niger, which borders the south of Libya, where Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune said in June 2021 that "Tripoli is a red line," adding that "Algeria was ready to intervene to prevent the fall of the Libyan capital to Haftar's forces." .

Niger.title: Niger: 3 Beninese suspected of fraud arrested in Gaya
Niger.summary: Three Beninese nationals were arrested in Gaya, Niger, in an alleged case of online fraud involving fake Customs auctions that allegedly resulted in more than 37 victims for an estimated provisional damage of 7 million FCFA . The ads appeared to come from the customs administration, but were actually used to extract money from Internet users, a case that led the Directorate of the Judicial Police (DPJ) of Niger to arrest three Beninese nationals suspected of belonging to a cyber fraud network, while a fourth alleged member, who resides in Benin, remains actively sought .

Niger.title: In the first external move since 1973, Algeria deploys its forces in Niger
Niger.summary: The first Algerian military convoy arrived in the city of Arlit, northwest of Niger, with the aim of securing the country's vital economic interests and energy projects in the Sahel region of Africa. The deployment of Algerian troops outside the country is the first of its kind since Algeria sent troops to support Egypt during the 1973 war with Israel, in which Arab countries participated.
